description: This Scala source file defines the StreamingQueryManager class, which manages active streaming queries within a SparkSession. It provides methods to retrieve active queries, get specific queries by ID, wait for termination, reset termination state, and manage query listeners.

classes.name: StreamingQueryManager
classes.description: Manages all active streaming queries in a SparkSession, allowing retrieval, control, and listener management.

methods.name: active
methods.description: Returns an array of all active StreamingQuery instances.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a StreamingQuery by UUID or String ID.

methods.name: awaitAnyTermination
methods.description: Waits for any streaming query to terminate, with optional timeout.

methods.name: resetTerminated
methods.description: Resets the termination state of streaming queries.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Adds a StreamingQueryListener to receive query events.

methods.name: executeManagerCmd
methods.description: Executes a command to the streaming query manager and returns the result.
